title: Startup Context Meter Renderer Extraction
premise: The primary genius cache is empty, so S111 uses the live innovation pack and code inspection. The next repo-owned slice is context-meter visual rendering inside the startup brief renderer; external launch proof gates remain honest deferrals.

items.why: The startup brief renderer still contained the context-meter tile rows even after meter loading was extracted. Moving the tile renderer into the meter helper reduces monolith ownership and puts observability formatting under focused regression coverage.
items.evidence: docs/INNOVATION_PACK.json reports scripts/render-startup-brief.mjs above the local maintainability threshold; live inspection showed the context-meter tile was pure rendering logic.
items.recipe: Export renderStartupContextMeterBlock from scripts/lib/startup-context-meter-block.mjs, replace the inline tile in scripts/render-startup-brief.mjs, add a focused regression, and validate the brief.

items.why: Six launch-proof gates still require real-world evidence. A good session keeps them visible while refusing fabricated evidence.
items.evidence: context/PROJECT_STATUS.json blockers enumerate the six proof gates; blocker-preflight reports 0 locally actionable Human Action Required items.
items.recipe: Leave the gates as explicit launch blockers until the corresponding real runner or provider evidence records proof.

honestDeferrals: No production auth email proof without a real mailbox flow.
No Stripe proof without a real purchase/portal/subscription smoke.
No friend-beta proof without a real tester pass.
No Brevo or Studio Ops Supabase capability proof without the corresponding Studio Ops/provider action.
No capture readiness claim until the browser-safe Supabase anon key is actually wired into production config.

executionLog.evidence: Context-meter tile rendering moved into scripts/lib/startup-context-meter-block.mjs; regression suite passed 6/6 after approved sandbox bypass.
External launch proof gates still require real mailbox/payment/tester/provider/deploy-config evidence; no proof fabricated.
